description: Delete the Docker containers, images, volumes and networks I create for testing, after checking each is mine and unused: labelled ones (claudia.scratch=true) freely, unlabelled leftovers by name or prefix, never compose stacks, running containers or images still in use.

delete.description:
Delete my Docker resources: --mine (everything labelled claudia.scratch=true), --prefix

(container names / image repositories), or named containers and repo:tags. Skips compose projects, running containers (--stop for labelled ones), images in use, and pulled images (--pulled). --dry-run reports. Logs each deletion.

args.name: name
args.description: Container names/IDs or image repo:tags (repeatable); or use --mine / --prefix
